architecture: synthetic little-endian uintb64 P-code IR via fixture Translate; spaces const=0/other=1/unique=2/ram=3/register=4/stack=5/join=6/iop=7; stack is an 8-byte SpacebaseSpace with negative growth
compiler_spec: per-case ProtoModel decoded from production <prototype> XML with an explicit <paramrange><range space=stack .../></paramrange> element, installed via FuncProto::setModel (Rugra: Architecture proto_models registry + FuncProto convention name, mirroring FuncProto::setScope's defaultfp fallback)

analysis_options.entrypoint: direct ScopeLocal::fakeInputSymbols call on the Funcdata-attached local scope
analysis_options.normalization: none; stdout is byte-compared; the rangemap overlap partition (one AddrRange piece per split boundary, rangemap::insert unzip) is normalized to one record per Symbol via getFirstWholeMap, matching Rugra's one-whole-map-per-Symbol model
analysis_options.external_input_assets: none; the complete input vector (input Varnodes, typelock flags, prototype models, pre-existing parameter symbols) is embedded in and fingerprinted with both fixture sources

adjacent: paramrange [8,515]; stack inputs 100+8 and 108+8 (adjacent, non-overlapping)
cross_space: paramrange [8,515]; inputs register 0x0+8 (outer continue), stack 0x10+8, join 0x0+8 (inner-loop space break), stack 0x20+8
typelock: paramrange [8,515]; stack inputs 0x10+8, 0x14+4 typelocked (group skipped), 0x30+8 (later group still runs)

input.state: each case builds a fresh Funcdata whose constructor attaches a fresh ScopeLocal (FuncProto gets the architecture default model via setScope's fallback, then the per-case model via setModel); input Varnodes are created through Funcdata::newVarnode + VarnodeBank::setInput (Rugra: VarnodeBank create + set_input) with the production unknown base type and no defining op; parameter symbols are added through Scope::addSymbol("", int-N, stack-addr, invalid-usepoint) + setCategory(function_parameter, 0); typelock is set directly on the Varnode flags; observation covers every whole symbol mapping in (space,first,last) order with name/displayName/category/catindex/size/typelock, the function_parameter category size, and the warning-header texts
